title: Standard Pistol
description: Modeled after the Taurus PT92 and Beretta 92FS, this standard-issue semi-automatic sidearm is ubiquitous across Los Santos law enforcement and street crews.
acquisitionTips: Automatically given to Michael and Franklin at the start of Story Mode; dropped by almost every LSPD officer.
Equip a Suppressor ($725) at Ammu-Nation for an early-game silent stealth sidearm.

title: Combat Pistol
description: Based on the Heckler & Koch P2000, offering improved stopping power, higher magazine capacity, and crisp semi-automatic recoil control.
acquisitionTips: Unlocks at Ammu-Nation after completing 'Complications' for $600, or pick it up for free during early Story Mode missions.
Features higher accuracy and tighter grouping than the Standard Pistol.

title: AP Pistol
description: An armor-piercing machine pistol inspired by the Colt SCAMP and OTs-33 Pernach, regarded as the premier drive-by sidearm due to its blistering automatic fire rate.
acquisitionTips: Unlocks at Ammu-Nation after completing the FIB mission 'Three's Company'.
Strictly outperforms the Micro SMG while driving — install the Extended Clip (36 rounds) to shred pursuing vehicles.

title: Heavy Revolver
description: A high-caliber six-shooter inspired by the Taurus Raging Bull, delivering devastating one-shot body damage at the expense of heavy cylinder cycle times.
acquisitionTips: Capable of dropping unarmored enemies in a single torso shot and damaging vehicle engine blocks.
Pair with Michael's Bullet Time special ability to negate its slow cylinder fire rate.

title: Micro SMG
description: Based on the iconic Mini Uzi, this compact submachine gun can be fired from within vehicles during high-speed chases and urban shootouts.
spawnLocations: Grove Street & Chamberlain Hills Gang Members
acquisitionTips: Unlocks at Ammu-Nation right after 'Franklin and Lamar' and is your primary drive-by weapon in the first half of the story.
Can be picked up for free behind the boat shed on the northern shore of the Alamo Sea.

title: SMG
description: The quintessential MP5 submachine gun with a collapsible stock, providing low muzzle climb and dependable intermediate-range automatic fire.
acquisitionTips: Unlocks after 'Father/Son' at Ammu-Nation, or can be looted from NOOSE tactical officers at 3+ Wanted Stars.
Note: Because of its full receiver and stock, the standard SMG cannot be fired from inside cars (use the Micro SMG or AP Pistol for drive-bys).

title: Combat PDW
description: Modeled after the SIG Sauer MPX, featuring an integrated suppressor shroud that muffles gunshots and prevents radar pings during stealth infiltration.
acquisitionTips: Comes with a built-in integral suppressor right out of the box, saving you the cost of a muzzle attachment.
Add the Scope and Grip at Ammu-Nation for laser-like burst accuracy at medium range.

title: Pump Shotgun
description: A 12-gauge Mossberg 590 pump-action shotgun found in every police cruiser, delivering lethal buckshot spreads at close-quarters room-clearing distances.
acquisitionTips: Free Acquisition: Stepping into any LSPD Police Cruiser or Sheriff SUV immediately awards you a Pump Shotgun with 5 shells.
Unlocks at Ammu-Nation after 'The Long Stretch'.

title: Sawed-Off Shotgun
description: A modified double-barrel break-action shotgun with shortened barrels, compact enough to be drawn and fired from motorcycles and bicycles.
spawnLocations: All Ammu-Nation Stores (Free with Social Club)
acquisitionTips: Free at Ammu-Nation when linked to Rockstar Games Social Club, or given to Trevor automatically during 'Mr. Philips'.
Can be fired one-handed while riding motorcycles such as the Bati 801 or Sanchez.

title: Assault Shotgun
description: Inspired by the UTAS UTS-15, this drum-fed fully-automatic combat shotgun dismantles vehicle armor and clears fortified corridors in seconds.
acquisitionTips: Unlocks at Ammu-Nation after 'blitz Play' for $1,500.
Equip the 32-round Extended Drum Magazine to turn it into the ultimate close-quarters room-clearing weapon for late-game heists and Rampages.

title: Carbine Rifle
description: Modeled after the ubiquitous Colt M4A1, the Carbine Rifle serves as the all-around benchmark for combat accuracy, handling, and tactical customization.
acquisitionTips: Automatically unlocked and equipped during 'The Jewel Store Job' (or unlocked at Ammu-Nation afterward for $2,100).
Also spawns as a free pickup on the NOOSE Headquarters rooftop helipad next to the Buzzard.

title: Assault Rifle
description: A rugged Kalashnikov AK-47 variant featuring stamping and wood furniture that delivers heavier per-bullet damage across medium combat ranges.
spawnLocations: Altruist Cult Camp (Chiliad Mountain State Wilderness)
acquisitionTips: Can be picked up early for free inside the Altruist Cult compound or dropped by Aztecas gang members in Blaine County.
Cheaper to purchase and upgrade than the Carbine Rifle while offering slightly higher base damage per shot.

title: Special Carbine
description: Based on the Heckler & Koch G36C, combining a lightweight polymer composite frame with superior muzzle velocity and recoil stabilization.
acquisitionTips: Available immediately from the very first visit to Ammu-Nation in Story Mode without waiting for mission unlocks.
Widely considered the best all-around assault rifle in GTA V when fitted with the Grip, Scope, and Extended Clip.

title: Advanced Rifle
description: A bullpup assault rifle based on the IWI Tavor CTAR-21, delivering rapid cyclic fire with compact maneuverability in confined corridors.
acquisitionTips: Boasts the highest fire rate of any assault rifle in the game, melting armored targets at close-to-medium range.
Unlocks at Ammu-Nation late in the story after 'The Big Score'.

title: Sniper Rifle
description: An AWM-style bolt-action precision marksman rifle equipped with high-magnification telescopic glass for long-range tactical target neutralization.
acquisitionTips: Given to Trevor for free during 'Nervous Ron' (complete with a Suppressor and Advanced Scope).
Required for completing several of Lester's Assassination missions cleanly from a distance.

title: Heavy Sniper
description: A devastating .50 BMG anti-materiel rifle based on the Barrett M82, capable of piercing engine blocks and taking down tail rotors in a single trigger pull.
spawnLocations: Central Los Santos Medical Center Roof (Davis)
acquisitionTips: Free Map Pickup: Climb the access ladders or land a helicopter on the roof of Central Los Santos Medical Center in Davis to grab the Heavy Sniper for free.
Unlocks at Ammu-Nation during 'Three's Company' and can shoot down police helicopters in two hits to the rotor hub.

title: Marksman Rifle
description: A designated marksman rifle modeled after the M14 EBR, providing rapid semi-automatic follow-up shots through an illuminated sniper optic.
acquisitionTips: Allows you to strafe while aiming down the sniper scope, unlike the bolt-action Sniper Rifle and Heavy Sniper.
Rapid semi-automatic fire makes it forgiving against moving vehicle targets.

title: RPG (Rocket Launcher)
description: The classic RPG-7 shoulder-fired rocket launcher, launching high-explosive anti-tank warheads that annihilate grouped infantry and light armored vehicles.
acquisitionTips: Free Map Pickup: Walk onto the steel maintenance catwalk underneath the Route 1 bridge spanning the Zancudo River (just south of Fort Zancudo) to collect a free RPG.
Can also be found on the upper porch inside the Altruist Cult compound in the Chiliad wilderness.

title: Minigun
description: A multi-barrel Gatling rotary heavy machine gun based on the M134, firing thousands of rounds per minute capable of tearing armored convoys to shreds.
spawnLocations: Fort Zancudo Air Traffic Control Tower (Top Floor)
acquisitionTips: Free Map Pickup: Enter the main door of the tall Air Traffic Control Tower in Fort Zancudo and take the elevator/stairs to the top locker room to find a free Minigun.
Unlocks at Ammu-Nation after completing 'The Paleto Score' for $15,000.

title: Sticky Bomb (C4)
description: Plastic explosive charges fitted with high-power adhesive backing and a remote radio frequency detonator, perfect for ambush traps and security van doors.
acquisitionTips: Unlocks at Ammu-Nation after 'Friends Reunited'.
Stick a single C4 charge directly onto the rear doors of a Gruppe Sechs Armored Security Van to blow open the cash doors immediately without triggering a prolonged chase.

title: Combat Knife
description: A 7-inch carbon steel fixed-blade tactical knife with serrated spine, tailored for silent takedowns and close-quarters hand-to-hand combat.
acquisitionTips: Available from the start of Story Mode at any Ammu-Nation counter for $100.
Essential for underwater shark defense while diving for Submarine Pieces and Nuclear Waste without a submersible.
